extracted.intended_audience: design students, exhibition-stand builders, and display designers
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions and design intent for creating a quick, three-faced exhibition stand (Prisma) using the tensile strength of foam board and aluminium channels to bind and finish edges.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the tensile strength of foam board
rubrics_metrics.description: Made by using the tensile strength of foam board, Prisma is a three-faced structural element.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rely on the material property (tensile strength) of foam board as the primary structural mechanism rather than heavy framing; choose foam board with sufficient tensile strength for the intended loads and spans.

rubrics_metrics.name: Three-faced structural element
rubrics_metrics.description: Prisma is a three-faced structural element, which can be used for multiple purposes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design the stand as a three-faced geometric unit (Prisma) so it can function in multiple roles (display, partition, plinth, etc.); maintain the three-faced form for structural integrity and versatility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bind edges of three foam boards to form a rigid structure
rubrics_metrics.description: The beauty of the detail of this structure lies in binding the edges of three foam boards to form a rigid structure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Join the foam board edges precisely so the assembled edges act compositely and produce rigidity; attention to edge-binding detail is both structural and aesthetic.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use aluminium channel to bind and finish edges
rubrics_metrics.description: The aluminium channel binds the foam board structure and gives a finish to the edges of the stand.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Incorporate aluminium channels as edge-binding elements to clamp and protect foam board seams while providing a clean finished appearance; select channel dimensions compatible with board thickness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fast/quick solution for exhibition stands
rubrics_metrics.description: It is a quick solution for an exhibition stand.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize simplicity and speed of fabrication/assembly in the design so the stand can be produced and installed rapidly; trade-offs between speed and durability should be considered for reuse.
